This is the repeat (fourth) bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.25/2021 registered at Police Station - Niwas, District Mandla (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Section 363, 366A and 376(3) of IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act.
2. As per the prosecution story, on 15.02.2021 prosecutrix had gone Mandla and did not return to her house, her parents have made a search and lodged the report against unknown person.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is in jail since 19.02.2021.
Prosecutrix is major aged about 19 years.
It is further submitted that, applicant is in custody since last three years and the trial is not concluded.
